title: Turning harvests into opportunity
summary: Connecting smallholder farmers to reliable buyers through a simple, shared marketplace.
problem: Smallholder farmers struggle to find consistent buyers, leading to lost produce and unpredictable income. Buyers have limited visibility into locally available harvests.
solution: AgroLink connects farmers and buyers with a mobile marketplace, harvest listings and coordinated collection points. The team proposes a pilot with 20 farms around Gaborone.

title: A smarter start for small businesses
summary: A pocket-sized business companion for informal traders to track sales and plan ahead.
problem: Informal traders often rely on paper records, making it difficult to understand cash flow or prepare financing applications.
solution: A low-data bookkeeping tool with daily sales records, simple cash-flow summaries and exportable business reports.

title: Waste today. Resources tomorrow.
summary: Making recycling accessible by linking households with local collectors and processors.
problem: Households have few convenient ways to separate and recycle waste, while collectors lack predictable collection routes.
solution: A neighbourhood collection platform with pickup requests, sorting guides and collection route coordination.

title: Local skills, stronger communities
summary: Helping young people turn practical skills into paid opportunities close to home.
problem: Young people with practical skills struggle to find trusted local customers and build a visible track record.
solution: A skills directory with verified profiles, local job requests and a portfolio of completed work.

title: Discover the Botswana beyond
summary: Putting community-led experiences on the map for curious, conscious travellers.
problem: Community tourism providers have limited digital visibility and depend on intermediaries to reach visitors.
solution: A discovery and booking prototype for locally hosted experiences, with transparent pricing and host profiles.

title: Every drop makes a difference
summary: Affordable water monitoring that helps small businesses spot leaks before they grow.
problem: Small businesses can lose water through undetected leaks and have little visibility into usage patterns.
solution: A low-cost sensor paired with a dashboard that flags unusual usage and provides simple conservation recommendations.

title: Healthcare within reach
summary: Simplifying appointment planning for rural communities and local clinics.
problem: Patients travel long distances without knowing clinic availability.
solution: An SMS-first appointment request and reminder service.
request: Please clarify the pilot clinic partnership and attach a consent plan.

title: One market for local makers
summary: A digital storefront connecting independent Botswana makers to new customers.
problem: Local makers lack affordable online selling tools.
solution: Shared storefronts and simple order management for craft businesses.

title: Learning without limits
summary: Offline learning resources designed for students with limited connectivity.
problem: Reliable internet is not available to every learner.
solution: Downloadable learning packs with progress tracking.
